text_block_list.text:
One day, as I walked past the school 
store—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Fueeh... I'm so cold...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Doto-san, cease this whining.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Behind us, there are still 100 more ice 
creams waiting!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... I'll do my best to eat them~...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No no no?! You don't have to eat them! Are 
you planning to empty the entire ice cream 
shelf?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hawa, Fukukitaru-san. B-But~...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If we don't eat the ice cream, we can't 
win the grand prize...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Grand prize...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. What one obtains from the winning 
ice cream stick... or rather, the grand 
prize, is the "Ultra Cozy Carrot Futon"!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A first-class item capable of resolving 
all fatigue and poor condition with just 
one night of sleep—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Urgh?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: King-san?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...This is a strategic and temporary 
retreat! By no means is it an act of 
giving u—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ngh, nghhhhuuuuughhhh!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: King-saaannn!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... What should I do...? No, there's 
nothing else for it but to keep eating, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but still, Doto-san? What if, just 
hypothetically, okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What if you eat 100 of them and still 
don't win? Then there's really no need to 
force yourself to eat them right now—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Even if that happens, no, if it does... 
I'll just go somewhere else and buy more 
ice creams.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Because... I feel like if I can just pull 
a winning stick, even a hopeless person 
like me might be able to do anything.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to stay like this... I don't 
want to stay the useless person I am 
forever.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I want to become a hardworking girl that I 
can actually be proud of...!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...I see, so it's a prayer of dedication!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Then meeting here must be destiny at work! 
Wishing for Doto-san's victory! I shall 
present you with a whole bunch of good 
luck charms!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: F-Fukukitaru-san...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll fetch it from the classroom 
posthaste! My prized good luck talisman... 
The "Winning Popsicle Stick I Won 10 Years 
Ago"!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eh, ehhh...? Ah... huh...?

And so, Meisho Doto kept eating ice cream, 
while Matikanefukukitaru continued 
cheering her on.

...Wouldn't they finish faster if they ate 
together? Swallowing that question, I kept 
watching over the two—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-Ah... I WONNN~~~!!

And so, Meisho Doto brilliantly acquired 
the "Warm Carrot Futon"— and apparently, 
used it the very next day.

...Because she had eaten far too much ice 
cream.
